# go-modern-slices-index

**Since:** Go 1.21

## Summary

Use slices.Index to find the index of an element, returning -1 when absent.

## Details

slices.Index is the direct index lookup for slices of comparable values.
It returns -1 when the value is absent, matching the common handwritten convention.

## Examples

### Before

```go
index := -1
for i, item := range items {
  if item == x {
    index = i
    break
  }
}
```

### After

```go
index := slices.Index(items, x)
```
